subject.title: feat(ui): hold-to-record dictation on the composer mic button

question: Should hold-to-record ship enabled by default on the existing composer microphone button, or should it be opt-in until the interaction has broader product validation?
rationale: The implementation introduces a new default interaction and persisted preference on an established control; tests cannot determine the intended default product behavior.

options.title: Ship default-on after finalization fix
options.body: Keep the proposed quick-tap/hold split, but first repair provider finalization and provide real configured-provider browser evidence.

options.title: Make dictation opt-in initially
options.body: Preserve the existing microphone interaction for current users and expose hold-to-record only after users enable the setting.

recommendation.title: Ship default-on after finalization fix
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed quick-tap/hold split, but first repair provider finalization and provide real configured-provider browser evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the proposed UI interaction and can incorporate maintainer direction into the branch.
